header: Your first 30 days with Vertex Supply
subheadline: Onboarding for a company with about 50 technicians, based on the last 12 rollouts. Your implementation lead sets these dates at the kick-off and keeps to them.

items.title: Kick-off and data handover
items.description: A 90-minute call to agree the rollout dates. Then you send the asset and customer data you have, in whatever form it is in.

items.title: Your register, corrected
items.description: We return the imported sites, assets and contracts for you to review. Most companies find duplicate sites here that nobody had noticed for years.

items.title: First crew goes live
items.description: Four or five technicians handle real calls in the app, and the rest of the team works as before. Their feedback shapes everyone's checklists.

items.title: Whole team on the board
items.description: Dispatch switches over on a Monday morning with your implementation lead on the phone. Paper job sheets stay available for two more weeks, then stop.
